title: Design version: up to five technicians can be pinned, with pin messages
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}, in a browser window at least 1024 px wide.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Six technicians are active at {Location-A}: {Technician-A}, {Technician-B}, {Technician-C}, {Technician-D}, {Technician-E} and {Technician-F}. None is pinned in your Board View.
    For example: ZZAUTOTEST C682432 Ana to ZZAUTOTEST C682432 Fay.
  • Starting screen: "Work Orders" > "All" tab, "Board View" shown, "Search" empty.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the pin on {Technician-A}'s column header.
  2. Click the pins on {Technician-B}'s, {Technician-C}'s and {Technician-D}'s headers.
  3. Click the pin on {Technician-E}'s header.
  4. Click the pin on {Technician-F}'s header.
  5. Click the pin on {Technician-A}'s header again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: {Technician-A} is pinned and a message reads "{Technician-A} pinned".
  • Step 2: all three are pinned.
  • Step 3: {Technician-E} is pinned: five technicians are pinned.
  • Step 4: {Technician-F} is not pinned and a message reads "Up to 5 pinned columns — unpin one first".
  • Step 5: {Technician-A} is unpinned and a message reads "{Technician-A} unpinned".

This case checks the DESIGN's version, which differs from the PRD: How many technicians can be pinned, and the pin messages: the design shows 5, with "Esther Howard pinned" / "unpinned" and "Up to 5 pinned columns — unpin one first"; the PRD says 3, with "You can pin up to 3 technicians.". It is held until Chris Ward rules on rows D10 of the WO Board design-differences question sheet for Chris Ward (19 Oct 2026). Do not run it while it is held. If he rules for the design, it is released; if he rules for the PRD, it is removed.
